justification: Assessment reported INVALID and targeted the same defect as ground truth: the claim that the expansion hypothesis forces delta(G) > alpha*n (Lemma 1) is false, and the proof's step 0052 contradiction does not follow since alpha <= 1/2 - 1/n holds for all large n. Its witness (K_{n-1} plus a vertex v of degree 1, alpha=0.4) is a valid instance of the same family as the ground-truth witness (K5 plus isolated vertex): any S of size n/2 contains two clique vertices whose neighborhoods cover V\{v}, giving |N(S)| >= n-1 >= n/2 + 0.4n for large n, while delta(G)=1 <= alpha*n.
